policies.readOnly: You can only view the shop rental policy.

confirm.body: The new policy applies to new bookings. Bookings already confirmed keep their original price and deposit.
confirm.bodyInheriting: The new policy applies immediately to {count, plural, other {# vehicle(s)}} inheriting it, starting from new bookings. Bookings already confirmed keep their original price and deposit.

paymentSettings.title: Reservation payment through XePrime
paymentSettings.subtitle: During this phase, every trip on XePrime collects the reservation amount from the customer before the trip is confirmed. This is NOT the security deposit you take at handover — that one you collect, hold and refund yourself, and it lives in the per-vehicle policy below.
paymentSettings.loadError: Could not load reservation payment settings
paymentSettings.readOnly: You can only view this setting. The shop owner is the one who turns it on or off.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You need the permission below to view this shop's reservation payment settings.

toggle.label: Let XePrime collect the reservation payment for me

mode.onTitle: Guests pay a reservation amount before the booking exists
mode.onBody: The customer scans a VietQR transfer to XePrime the moment they book, within 10 minutes (auto-extended up to twice). The slot is held while they pay, and the request only reaches you once the money has arrived — no more approving and then waiting to see whether they pay. This amount is PART of the rental price; the customer pays you the rest directly at handover. If you decline, they are refunded in full.
mode.offTitle: You arrange it with the guest yourself
mode.offBody: Approving creates the booking straight away, with no wait for money. You contact the guest to arrange the security deposit at pickup — XePrime neither collects nor reconciles it, so if a dispute arises XePrime has no record to support you.

platform.title: XePrime collects the reservation amount for every shop
platform.body: During this phase every trip on XePrime collects the reservation amount from the customer up front, regardless of plan. The switch is locked for now and will reopen later; your saved choice is kept and will apply again then.

commission.title: Your shop always collects deposits through XePrime
commission.body: You are on the commission track: no subscription fee, and XePrime charges a per-trip service fee on the customer side. The reservation payment is a condition of this track, so the switch is locked. Move to a subscription plan if you want to decide for yourself.

featureMissing.title: Your current plan does not include this
featureMissing.body: Collecting the reservation payment through XePrime is part of the subscription plan. Until then you still take bookings as usual and arrange the security deposit with guests directly at handover.

notConfigured.title: We cannot determine your shop plan
notConfigured.body: We could not read an active service plan for your shop, so fees cannot be calculated and new bookings are paused. This is a XePrime configuration problem, not something you did. Contact support to get it fixed.

paymentSettings.frozen: Changing this switch only affects rental requests approved from now on. Existing bookings keep the arrangement frozen when they were created.

pending.title: Waiting for XePrime to verify your profile
pending.body: Nothing changes for your vehicles: approved ones stay on the marketplace and keep taking bookings.

needsRevision.title: XePrime needs more details
needsRevision.body: Update what was asked for and submit again. Your vehicles keep running in the meantime.

rejected.title: Verification declined
rejected.body: Fix the points below and submit again. This does not affect the vehicles you already have listed.
